title: Thermostat
description: A thermostat with a target temperature (bounded by min/max) and a mode. Setting a temperature outside the bounds leaves the target unchanged.

setTemperature.title: Set Temperature
setTemperature.description: Set the target temperature, if within [minTemp, maxTemp]; otherwise no change.
setTemperature.vre:effects: targetTemp' = (temp <= maxTemp && temp >= minTemp) ? temp : targetTemp; output.success = (temp <= maxTemp && temp >= minTemp); output.targetTemp = targetTemp';

setMode.title: Set Mode
setMode.description: Set the operating mode (e.g. auto, heat, cool).
setMode.vre:effects: mode' = mode; output.success = true; output.mode = mode';
